verdict.rationale:
Docs confirm hardware ordering and reader registration/configuration directly from the Dashboard (docs-32, docs-5, docs-20, docs-44) and no-code acceptance options (docs-21, docs-26, docs-31), supporting a founder's ability to get set up for in-person payments quickly. However, there is no evidence describing the account signup/approval process, approval timelines, or shipping/delivery speed for hardware, so the 'same week' claim is unverified.
missing for 10: evidence of signup/approval flow and timeline, hardware shipping/delivery speed, independent confirmation of onboarding speed.
